payload.title: Decide how nav treats sections with little in them
payload.description: The nav has six destinations, some of them thin today. The review says it reflects the software more than the reader. Note that the branding plan assumes a mature, populated publication, so weigh this against that: changes should make sense for the mature site, not only for today's volume. Options include leading with Stories and Posts and grouping Findings, Videos, Conversations and Concepts as a second layer. Ryan decides.
